// main's code at 226bd08, byte-for-byte: the "old" reference for sync-guards CZ2 (the calendar and On Call Today on a
// week WITHOUT a Sunday handoff must read exactly as before). Five pieces of index-source.html, each after a line
// "//@@ <name> — <where>".
//@@ calData — the calData memo's body: after "  const calData = useMemo(() => {", up to "\n  }, [schedule, appShifts]);"

    const d={};
    Object.entries(schedule).forEach(([mStr,wk])=>{
      const mon=parse(mStr);
      const pfx = wk.isBackup ? "B-" : "";
      const cls = wk.isBackup ? "backup" : "primary";
      const holCov = wk.holidayCoverage || {};
      if(wk.dayCall){
        for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
          const ds=fmt(addD(mon,i));
          // Skip Svc entry on days covered by a holiday 24h surgeon
          if(holCov[ds]) continue;
          d[ds]=[...(d[ds]||[]),{type:pfx+"Svc",surgeon:(wk.dayCallOverrides&&wk.dayCallOverrides[ds])||wk.dayCall,cls}];
        }
        const sat=fmt(addD(mon,5));
        if(!holCov[sat]) d[sat]=[...(d[sat]||[]),{type:pfx+"Wknd",surgeon:(wk.dayCallOverrides&&wk.dayCallOverrides[sat])||wk.dayCall,cls,note:"Sat 7a–7a"}];
      }
      NIGHT_KEYS.forEach((sk,i)=>{
        const sid=wk.nights?.[sk]; if(!sid) return;
        const ds=fmt(addD(mon,i));
        if(holCov[ds]) return; // Holiday 24h covers this night
        d[ds]=[...(d[ds]||[]),{type:pfx+"Ngt",surgeon:sid,cls}];
      });
      const wkndS = wk.nights?.wknd;
      if(wkndS){
        const fri=fmt(addD(mon,4));
        if(!holCov[fri]) d[fri]=[...(d[fri]||[]),{type:pfx+"Wknd",surgeon:wkndS,cls,note:"5p–7a"}];
        const sun=fmt(addD(mon,6));
        if(!holCov[sun]) d[sun]=[...(d[sun]||[]),{type:pfx+"Wknd",surgeon:wkndS,cls,note:"7a–7a"}];
      }
      if(wk.isBackup){
        for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
          const ds=fmt(addD(mon,i));
          d[ds]=[...(d[ds]||[]),{type:"Fierce",surgeon:null,cls:"fierce"}];
        }
      }
      if(wk.isFierceBackup){
        for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
          const ds=fmt(addD(mon,i));
          d[ds]=[...(d[ds]||[]),{type:"FierceBkp",surgeon:null,cls:"fiercebkp"}];
        }
      }
      // Holiday coverage
      if (wk.holidayCoverage) {
        Object.entries(wk.holidayCoverage).forEach(([ds, cov]) => {
          d[ds]=[...(d[ds]||[]),{type:"Holiday",surgeon:cov.surgeonId,cls:"holiday",role:cov.role,hours:cov.hours,holName:cov.name,holType:cov.type,holiday:cov.holiday}];
        });
      }
    });
    // APP shifts
    Object.entries(appShifts).forEach(([ds,aid])=>{
      d[ds]=[...(d[ds]||[]),{type:"APP",appId:aid,cls:"app"}];
    });
    // DAVENPORT CALL TYPES ONLY. Owner decision 2026-09-24: FAK's Silvis days
    // come OFF the calendar (a Show-bar toggle + his Mine section follow — and
    // they will read silvisDays directly, never through calData). #55 pushed
    // {type:"Silvis"} rows here, and the cell's generic S/N/W predicate — a
    // deny-list that renders anything not Svc/Wknd as a NIGHT — drew every one
    // as a phantom "N FAK" chip, on the public link and the OR board too (live
    // 2026.09.24a → 24d). Pinned behaviorally in test/sync-guards.js §O4: the
    // memo runs on a fixture and must emit no foreign type.
    return d;
//@@ cellChips — the month cell's generic S / N / W chips, an expression: "entries.filter(e=>{" through its ".map((e,j)=>{ … })"
entries.filter(e=>{
                    if(e.type==="Fierce"||e.type==="FierceBkp"||e.type==="APP"||e.type==="Holiday"||e.type==="Silvis") return false;
                    const isD = e.type.includes("Svc");
                    const isW = e.type.includes("Wknd");
                    if(isD && !calFilters.svc) return false;
                    if(isW && !calFilters.wknd) return false;
                    if(!isD && !isW && !calFilters.night) return false;
                    if(sf && e.surgeon !== sf) return false;
                    if(calDeptFilter && !(SURGEON_DEPTS[sMap[e.surgeon]?.name]||[]).includes(calDeptFilter)) return false;
                    return true;
                  }).map((e,j)=>{
                    const isB = e.cls==="backup";
                    const isD = e.type.includes("Svc");
                    const isW = e.type.includes("Wknd");
                    const label = isD?"S":isW?"W":"N";
                    const color = isD?"#3080a8":isW?"#908050":"#6850a0";
                    const highlighted = sf && e.surgeon === sf;
                    return (
                      <div key={j} style={{marginBottom:1,padding:"1px 3px",borderRadius:3,fontSize:10,
                        background:highlighted?"#e0f0ff":isB?"#fef8e8":isD?"#f8f9fb":isW?"#faf8f0":"#f4f0f8",
                        border:`1px solid ${highlighted?"#80b8e0":isB?"#d8c880":isD?"#d0dce8":isW?"#faf0d8":"#141028"}`,
                        opacity:isB?0.85:1,
                      }}>
                        {isB&&<span style={{color:"#8a6a10",fontWeight:700,fontSize:8,marginRight:2}}>B</span>}
                        <span style={{color,fontWeight:700}}>{label}</span>
                        {" "}
                        <span style={{color:surgeonColors(sMap[e.surgeon]?.name, sMap[e.surgeon]?.idx).tx||"#4a5868",fontWeight:highlighted?700:400}}>{sMap[e.surgeon]?.name||"?"}</span>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })
//@@ todayCall — the todayCall memo's body: after "  const todayCall = useMemo(() => {", up to "\n  }, [todayEntries, sMap, aMap]);"

    const info = { dayCall: null, night: null, weekend: null, app: null, fierce: false, fierceBkp: false, holiday: null };
    todayEntries.forEach(e => {
      // A covered holiday replaces that date's Svc/Ngt/Wknd rows in calData, so it is the day's 24h holder.
      // The label comes from the holiday's own name (a multi-day holiday's coverage name is only "Fri 24h").
      if (e.type === "Holiday") info.holiday = { who: sMap[e.surgeon]?.name || null, label: e.holType === "swap" ? (e.holName || "Coverage") : holidayTitleName({ holiday: e.holiday, label: e.holName }), emoji: holidayEmoji(e.holiday || e.holName) };
      if (e.type === "Svc" || e.type === "B-Svc") info.dayCall = sMap[e.surgeon]?.name || null;
      if (e.type === "Ngt" || e.type === "B-Ngt") info.night = sMap[e.surgeon]?.name || null;
      if (e.type === "Wknd" || e.type === "B-Wknd") info.weekend = sMap[e.surgeon]?.name || null;
      if (e.type === "APP") info.app = aMap[e.appId]?.name || null;
      if (e.type === "Fierce") info.fierce = true;
      if (e.type === "FierceBkp") info.fierceBkp = true;
    });
    return info;
//@@ buildTonightMsg — buildTonightMsg's body: after "  const buildTonightMsg = () => {", up to "\n  };"

    const today = new Date();
    const dayName = ["Sunday","Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday"][today.getDay()];
    const mo = today.getMonth()+1;
    const dy = today.getDate();
    const dow = today.getDay();
    const appTimeLabel = (dow === 0 || dow === 6) ? "7a–7a" : "5p–7a";
    let msg = `🏥 DSG Call — ${dayName} ${mo}/${dy}\n\n`;
    if (todayCall.holiday) msg += `${todayCall.holiday.emoji} ${todayCall.holiday.label} 24h (7a–7a): ${todayCall.holiday.who || "Unassigned"}\n`;
    if (todayCall.dayCall) msg += `🏥 Service Week: ${todayCall.dayCall}\n`;
    if (todayCall.night) msg += `🌙 Night (5p–7a): ${todayCall.night}\n`;
    if (todayCall.weekend) msg += `🌗 Weekend: ${todayCall.weekend}\n`;
    if (todayCall.app) msg += `👩‍⚕️ APP (${appTimeLabel}): ${todayCall.app}\n`;
    if (todayCall.fierce) msg += `⚡ Fierce Primary Week\n`;
    if (todayCall.fierceBkp) msg += `🛡 Fierce Backup Week\n`;
    if (!hasCallToday) msg += `No call assignments found for today.\n`;
    msg += `\n📋 Full schedule: https://fkhan628.github.io/Call-Schedule-App/`;
    return msg;
//@@ bannerChips — the On Call Today banner's chip row: its <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,flexWrap:"wrap"}}> through its own </div>
<div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                {todayCall.holiday && (
                  <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:6,padding:"6px 12px",background:"#fef0e8",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e0a868"}}>
                    <span style={{fontSize:16}}>{todayCall.holiday.emoji}</span>
                    <div>
                      <div style={{fontSize:10,color:"#a04810",fontWeight:600,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:0.5}}>{todayCall.holiday.label} · 24h 7a–7a</div>
                      <div style={{fontSize:15,fontWeight:700,color:"#1a2a3a"}}>{todayCall.holiday.who || "Unassigned"}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
                {todayCall.dayCall && (
                  <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:6,padding:"6px 12px",background:"#f0f8ff",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #c0d8f0"}}>
                    <span style={{fontSize:16}}>☀️</span>
                    <div>

                      <div style={{fontSize:15,fontWeight:700,color:"#1a2a3a"}}>{todayCall.dayCall}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
                {todayCall.night && (
                  <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:6,padding:"6px 12px",background:"#f8f0ff",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #d0c0f0"}}>
                    <span style={{fontSize:16}}>🌙</span>
                    <div>
                      <div style={{fontSize:10,color:"#6030a0",fontWeight:600,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:0.5}}>Tonight 5p–7a</div>
                      <div style={{fontSize:15,fontWeight:700,color:"#1a2a3a"}}>{todayCall.night}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
                {todayCall.weekend && (
                  <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:6,padding:"6px 12px",background:"#faf8f0",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e0d8c0"}}>
                    <span style={{fontSize:16}}>🌗</span>
                    <div>
                      <div style={{fontSize:10,color:"#7a6030",fontWeight:600,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:0.5}}>Weekend</div>
                      <div style={{fontSize:15,fontWeight:700,color:"#1a2a3a"}}>{todayCall.weekend}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
                {todayCall.app && (()=>{
                  const dow = new Date().getDay();
                  const appTimeLabel = (dow === 0 || dow === 6) ? "APP 7a–7a" : "APP 5p–7a";
                  return (
                  <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:6,padding:"6px 12px",background:"#fcf4f0",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e8d0c0"}}>
                    <span style={{fontSize:16}}>👩‍⚕️</span>
                    <div>
                      <div style={{fontSize:10,color:"#985020",fontWeight:600,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:0.5}}>{appTimeLabel}</div>
                      <div style={{fontSize:15,fontWeight:700,color:"#1a2a3a"}}>{todayCall.app}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  );
                })()}
              </div>
